request.what: Funding for four Hydra v2 workstreams: performance optimization, operational excellence, ecosystem support, and maintenance/developer experience to deliver a feature-complete and hardened Hydra v2.

claims.claim: Hydra is described as the only production-grade or production-ready Layer 2 scaling solution on Cardano.
The proposal requests ₳5,100,781 and states the funding will be milestone-gated with independent third-party assurance and Intersect administrative treasury governance.
Hydra is claimed to deliver sub-second finality, near-zero or zero fees inside a head, high throughput, and L1-grade settlement guarantees.
The document states Hydra has powered or is used by Delta DeFi, Masumi, Hydra Doom, Glacier Drop, Intersect voting infrastructure, VTech Labs, Blockfrost, and Midgard.
The proposal claims the four workstreams will scale Hydra adoption through performance, operations, ecosystem support, and developer-experience improvements.
The document claims Cardano L1 finality, fees, and throughput make high-performance applications uncompetitive versus other ecosystems, causing builders to exclude Cardano early.
The proposal claims Hydra applications can increase L1 settlement usage and potentially route internal head fees to the L1 treasury on settlement.
The document claims a single Hydra Head can process up to 1,000+ TPS in payment benchmarks and that aggregate throughput scales close to linearly across independent heads.

The proposal claims Hydra supports use cases including institutional OTC settlement, agent-to-agent commerce, B2B payment rails, prediction markets, institutional DEXes, RWA platforms, gaming, verifiable information processing, point of sale, and micropayments.

summary: The document presents a large treasury request for Hydra v2 hardening and adoption work, with substantial technical and adoption claims but limited budget, feasibility, alternatives, failure-mode, and impact analysis in the supplied text.
